SELECT m.mem_idx, m.mem_id, m.mem_pwd, m.mem_name, m.mem_tel, m.mem_gmail AS mem_email, m.mem_role_idx, m.mem_grade_idx, m.mem_bday, m.mem_regdate,
r.role_name AS mem_role_name, g.grade_name AS mem_grade_name, g.grade_discount_rate AS discount_rate,
mp.mem_nickname, mp.mem_intro, mp.mem_img,
ma.mem_zipcode, ma.mem_addr, ma.mem_addr_detail

WHERE m.mem_id = #{mem_id} AND m.mem_pwd = #{mem_pwd}
